data.name: Balbir
data.gender_notes: Balbir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balbir is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bal' (brave) and 'Bir' (lion). The name signifies being courageous like a lion. In Hindu mythology, Balbir is a name of Lord Hanuman, who is revered for his bravery and unwavering devotion. The name Balbir carries the meaning “Brave as a Lion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balbir usually hope their child will grow to embody brave as a lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Remain fearless in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Balbir belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave as a Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balbir total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
